configurePresets.name: vixen-ninja
configurePresets.description: Ninja generator so CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER (sccache) is honored and dependency tracking is fine-grained. Embedded (/Z7) debug info is required for sccache to cache MSVC debug builds (separate-PDB /Zi is non-cacheable and causes C1041 under parallel cl.exe). gtest_discover_tests runs at test time (PRE_TEST), not build time, so the build never executes test exes. Requires an MSVC environment (run from a VS Developer prompt or after vcvars64.bat). binaryDir lives under the consolidated ../build/ parent alongside every other preset's output.

configurePresets.name: vixen-wsl
configurePresets.description: Native Linux/GCC build for WSL2. Ninja generator; auto-provisions the LunarG Vulkan SDK (glslc + headers) into ${sourceDir}/.vulkan-sdk on first configure (VIXEN_AUTO_PROVISION_VULKAN defaults ON). Mesa-Dozen (Vulkan-over-D3D12 GPU) provisioning is ON by default — lavapipe (software Vulkan) validates neither performance nor real-driver behavior and produced false confidence (hangs/artifacts that don't reproduce on the real GPU); Dozen is the default so tests and interactive runs exercise the canonical path. First configure builds Mesa from source (a few minutes; cached at ~/.cache/vixen/wsl-vulkan after). Run tests with VK_ICD_FILENAMES=~/.cache/vixen/wsl-vulkan/dzn_icd.json and VK_LAYER_PATH=${sourceDir}/.vulkan-sdk/<ver>/x86_64/share/vulkan/explicit_layer.d. Set VIXEN_AUTO_PROVISION_WSL_VULKAN=OFF to fall back to lavapipe (e.g. no /dev/dxg GPU passthrough available). binaryDir lives under the consolidated ../build/ parent, alongside ../build/ninja and ../build/wsl-debug.

configurePresets.name: vixen-wsl-debug
configurePresets.displayName: VIXEN WSL Debug (Linux/GCC, unoptimized, descriptor tracking available)
configurePresets.description: Same Linux/GCC/WSL2 setup as vixen-wsl, but CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug (unoptimized, real symbols — needed for gdb/lldb backtraces, since vixen-wsl's Release build inlines/optimizes away the frames a debugger needs). Also the only preset where VIXEN_ENABLE_DESCRIPTOR_TRACKING is settable (it hard-requires Debug — see Debug/DescriptorResourceTracker.h and the root CMakeLists.txt gate). Pass -DVIXEN_ENABLE_DESCRIPTOR_TRACKING=ON to turn on descriptor resource lifecycle tracking for this configure. Mesa-Dozen provisioning is ON by default (see vixen-wsl's description); set VIXEN_AUTO_PROVISION_WSL_VULKAN=OFF for lavapipe.
